Where I work

Dec 2025 – present
Navi Mumbai

Data Analyst, Titan Crushing Equipment LLP

I turn data from many systems into one reliable view, then into dashboards that production, inventory and logistics teams use to make decisions.

  • Collect and cleanPull data from SQL Server, MySQL, Excel, APIs and cloud databases using SQL and Power Query.
  • One source of truthMaintain a centralized database and reconcile data so reports stay accurate and consistent.
  • Dashboards and KPIsBuild Power BI dashboards and reports with data models and DAX measures for production planning, inventory and logistics.
  • AutomationAutomate recurring reports and ETL workflows with Python, Google Apps Script and Power Automate, which cuts manual effort.
  • Working with teamsWork with operations, engineering and management to turn business needs into technical specs, present ad-hoc analysis, and train end users on the dashboards.
